title: 第398章 破门第397章 山雨欲来
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 第398章破门
“即刻持我令牌，飞马赶往东城校场，点齐所有披甲精锐，火速驰援真君庙！
允许你临机决断，必要时可动用强弩、火器，务求全功！”
叶欣诚接过令牌，转身欲走。
“且慢！”
高鹏程又叫住他，目光如电，“传令城中四门紧闭，加强戒备，提防贼人调虎离山或另有奸细！
令团练使集结城中所有可用团丁，上城协防！
通知府衙各房，进入战时状态，一切以军情优先！”
“遵命！”
叶欣诚抱拳，身影如风般卷出书房。
高鹏程深吸一口气，压下狂跳的心脏和纷乱的思绪。
他看了一眼僵在门边、脸色苍白却眼神执拗的刘锋，此刻已无暇细究他复杂的神情。
“刘锋！”
高鹏程沉声道。
“小……小人在。”
刘锋声音有些发干。
高鹏程看到刘锋这副怯懦样子，这才猛然反应过来——眼前这个，不过是个靠卖唱为生、带着幼妹、腿脚还不便的少年郎，并非自己麾下那些久经训练、悍不畏死的军士，更非锦衣卫中那些见惯了腥风血雨的番子。
心头一软，高鹏程的声音缓和了些许，带着一丝不易察觉的歉意与疲惫：“你且自行回家去吧。
接下来城里城外恐怕都不安生，紧闭门户，照顾好你妹妹，自己……多加小心。”
刘锋闻言，紧绷的肩膀似乎微微放松了一丝，他抬起头，飞快地看了高鹏程一眼，深深一揖：“谢……谢大人体恤。小人这就回去。”
说罢，他不再停留，背起二胡，转身，一瘸一拐地走出了书房，身影很快消失在门外昏暗的回廊中，脚步声轻微而急促。
高鹏程望着他消失的方向，心中那股莫名的怅惘与不安再次泛起，但此刻军情如火，容不得他多想。
他摇摇头，强行将杂念抛开，开始快速布置后续事宜，更换甲胄，点齐亲卫。
刘锋几乎是跑着离开府衙的。
心脏在胸腔里狂跳，不知是因为方才的紧张，还是因为别的什么。他低着头，在已经开始骚动起来的街道上疾走。
街面已然不复平日的秩序，得到风声的百姓慌慌张张地收拾摊位、关闭门户；一队队衙役和团丁跑步穿过街道，大声吆喝着驱散人群，前往各自防区；马蹄声不时响起，那是传递军令的驿卒或调动的兵马。
空气中弥漫着恐慌、焦灼以及一种山雨欲来的压抑。
“这日子……什么时候才是个头……”
刘锋心中苦涩地叹息。
他加快脚步，几乎是拖着那条不便的腿在小跑，穿过越来越混乱的街巷，终于回到了城西那片破败的棚户区，回到了他和囡囡栖身的那处摇摇欲坠的刘家小院。
推开吱呀作响的破木门，一个小小的身影立刻从昏暗的屋里扑了出来，一头扎进他怀里，带着哭腔：“阿哥！你总算回来了！外面……外面好吵，好多人跑，是不是要打仗了？”
正是囡囡。
她已经十三岁了，出落得比同龄女孩更加漂亮，但那双眼睛依旧清澈明亮，此刻却盛满了恐惧。
她紧紧抱着刘锋的腰，小身子在微微发抖。
刘锋的心瞬间软成了一滩水，他蹲下身，将囡囡紧紧搂在怀里，轻轻拍着她的背，努力让自己的声音听起来平稳：“囡囡别怕，有阿哥在。是有些乱，但高大人已经派兵去打了，咱们在城里，关好门，没事的。”
content_en:
Chapter 398 Breaking the Door
"Immediately take my token and rush to the Dongcheng campus on Pegasus. All the armored elites will rush to the aid of the True Lord Temple!
You are allowed to make decisions on the fly, and use crossbows and firearms when necessary to ensure full success! "
"Yes!"
Ye Xincheng took the token and turned to leave.
"Wait!"
Gao Pengcheng stopped him again, his eyes as bright as lightning, "I am ordering the four gates in the city to be closed tightly, and to be on guard to be on guard against thieves or spies!
Order the regiment commander to assemble all the available regiment members in the city and go to the city to assist in the defense!
Notify all offices in the government office to enter a wartime state, and prioritize military affairs! "
"As you command!"
Ye Xincheng clasped his fists and rolled out of the study like the wind.
Gao Pengcheng took a deep breath to suppress his racing heart and chaotic thoughts.
He glanced at Liu Feng, who was frozen by the door with a pale face but stubborn eyes. At this moment, he had no time to study his complicated expression.
"Liu Feng!"
Gao Pengcheng said in a deep voice.
"Little...little man is here."
Liu Feng's voice was a little dry.
When Gao Pengcheng saw Liu Feng's cowardly look, he suddenly realized - the man in front of him was just a young man who made a living as a singer, had a young girl, and had inconvenient legs and feet. He was not the soldiers under his command who had been trained for a long time and were not afraid of death, nor was he a member of the Imperial Guard who was used to seeing bloodshed.
His heart softened, Gao Pengcheng's voice softened a little, with a hint of apology and fatigue that was not easy to detect: "You can go home on your own.
Next, I'm afraid there will be no peace in the city or outside the city. Close the door tightly, take good care of your sister, and... be more careful. "
Hearing this, Liu Feng's tense shoulders seemed to relax slightly. He raised his head, glanced at Gao Pengcheng quickly, and bowed deeply: "Thank you... thank you for your sympathy. I will go back now."
After that, he stopped staying, picked up his erhu, turned around, and limped out of the study. His figure quickly disappeared into the dim corridor outside the door, and his footsteps were soft and quick.
Gao Pengcheng looked at the direction in which he disappeared, and the inexplicable sadness and uneasiness in his heart emerged again, but at the moment, the military situation was so fierce that he could not allow him to think too much.
He shook his head, forced aside his distracting thoughts, and began to quickly arrange the follow-up matters, changing his armor and ordering his personal guards.
Liu Feng almost ran out of the government office.
My heart was beating wildly in my chest, I don't know if it was because of the nervousness just now, or because of something else. He lowered his head and walked quickly on the streets that had begun to become commotion.
The streets were no longer in their usual order. People who got wind of the incident hurriedly packed up their stalls and closed their doors; groups of government officials and regimental officers ran through the streets, shouting loudly to disperse the crowd and headed for their respective defense areas; the sound of horse hooves sounded from time to time, which was the postmen delivering military orders or the mobilization of soldiers and horses.
The air is filled with panic, anxiety and a sense of depression that is about to come.
"This day... when will it end..."
Liu Feng sighed bitterly in his heart.
He quickened his pace, almost dragging his inconvenient leg at a trot, through the increasingly chaotic streets, and finally returned to the dilapidated shanty town in the west of the city, and to the crumbling Liu family courtyard where he and his daughter lived.
Pushing open the creaking broken wooden door, a small figure immediately jumped out of the dim room, threw himself into his arms, and cried: "Brother! You are finally back! It's so noisy outside, and many people are running away. Is there going to be a war?"
It's Nannan.
She was already thirteen years old, and she was more beautiful than girls of the same age, but her eyes were still clear and bright, but at this moment they were full of fear.
She hugged Liu Feng's waist tightly, her little body trembling slightly.
Liu Feng's heart instantly softened into a puddle. He squatted down, held Nan tightly in his arms, patted her back gently, and tried to make his voice sound calm: "Don't be afraid, Nan, I'm here. There is some chaos, but Mr. Gao has sent troops to fight. We are in the city, close the door, it will be fine."
